working_definition: Nuclei of the authors' 'yolk nuclei' cluster(s) (Calderon et al. 2022), embryos 0-18 h.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Nucleus that stays behind in the yolky interior of the syncytial embryo following the migration of a subset of nuclei to the periphery from cycle 8. There are around 50 of these nuclei. Yolk nuclei cease dividing in cycle 10 and become polyploid.

justification: The authors' annotation 'yolk nuclei'. FBbt's yolk nucleus is a cell component, not a cell; accepted as the data are nuclei (curator).
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00000057 yolk nucleus (exact match).
